senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (इलति)
1 To sleep.
2 To go.
3 To throw, send or direct: in this last sense, it is also r. 10th cl. (एलयति.)

f. (-ला)
1 The wife of BUDDHA, and daughter of IKṢVĀKU.
2 The earth.
3 A cow.
4 Speech.
E.
इल to send, क and टाप् affixes; also इडा.

n. (-लं)
The earth, the globe.
E.
इला and गोल a sphere.

n. (-लं)
1 The fourth place in the circle^1 of the zodiac.
2 The surface of the earth.
E.
इला and तल below.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-तं)
One of the nine Varṣas or divisions of the known world, comprehending the highest and most centrical part of the old continent.
E.
इला the earth, and आवृत chosen: the fairest part of the globe.

m. (-लः)
A bird.
E.
इल to go, and अल who is able.
